## Considered and refused

- Νέστωρ Νηλήϊος, l "Nestor the Neleian" / i "Nestor, son of Neleus": looks like a departure from Νηλήϊαι ἵπποι (i "the Neleian horses"), but iliad-058 has exactly this for Nestor (l "the Neleian", i "son of Neleus"); kept, and recorded in new-renderings already.
- δουρὶ κλειτός, l "famed for the spear" without hyphens (row 5.55 has "famed-for-the-spear"): the edition prints two words here and the hyphen marks a one-word compound; kept.
- 288 l "had excelled" (pluperfect) beside i "excelled" and the note’s "simple past sense": l keeps the form, i gives the sense, note explains; kept.
- 344 i "drive past the others": an object the Greek leaves understood, natural English; kept.
- 325 i "keeps his eye on the post" for τέρμ’ ὁρόων: fine in force; kept. 322 i "knows how to gain an advantage" for κέρδεα εἰδῇ: a paraphrase, but the note says "points of advantage"; kept.
- 333 i "has made it his turning-post" (l "has set the turning-posts"): plural to singular, the note says why; kept.
- 354 note "κρείων … ‘lord’ as everywhere": strictly εὐρὺ κρείων is "wide-ruling", but the row says "lord" for κρείων alone; kept.
- 335 note on τοῖιν as dual genitive: could be dative but the genitive after ἐπ’ ἀριστερά is the usual reading; kept.
- Line 290 repeats iliad-042’s line and the l is identical; the unit as a whole differs from 042’s, so no validator constraint; kept.
- 326: l and i identical to odyssey-052 apart from the stop; kept.

## For the caller (new-renderings.md, not edited by me)

Rows that now disagree with `units.json` or with the table and must be corrected before the table copy: ἱμᾶσιν (now "oxhide straps" / "straps"; the "avoided" column listed "straps"); ἄγχι παραστάς (the 20.190 row is Iliad, not "Odyssey table"; l is "standing close by"); Πυλοιγενέες (i "born at Pylos", the row listed it as avoided); Νηληϊάδαο (i "Neleus’ son"); ἄεθλα (l "contest-prizes"); ἀΐξασκε (l "darted up", i "darted up"; "leapt" was used); ἐσσυμένως row is fine. νύσσα "turning-point" and the other new rows stand.

## Gloss pass

Checked all 109 novel-form entries against the lines in units.json (lemma, meaning, tense/mood/case labels, Attic equivalent, no line numbers or "here", typographic ’ only, under 230 characters) and all 19 `__broaden__` entries (old entry kept whole + ` · ` + new reading). Edits to gloss.json by script (13 entries touched):

- αἴθην, μεταστοιχί, πόδαργον: opening ‘ changed to ’ (typographic quote rule).
- δοάσσεται: Attic equivalent added (δόξῃ).
- κέκλοντο: Attic equivalent added (ἐκελεύοντο).
- κένσαι: "epic" replaced by the Attic equivalent κεντῆσαι.
- ναῖεν: "epic -εν" was a false label (the -ν is movable ν); now "with movable ν (= Attic ἔναιε)".
- ξυνοχῇσιν: sense marked uncertain (the unit note at 328 says so).
- ἔτραφεν: "intrans. aor." made "aor. 3 pl. pass. (intransitive)", agreeing with the note at 346.
- ἀΐξασκε: meaning and translation conformed to the unit ("kept darting up", not "leaping"); Attic ᾔσσε added.
- __broaden__ ζυγόν: new reading said "ὑπό in tmesis" for ὕπαγε at 291; ὕπαγε is the compound verb (accent), so the tmesis label was false; reworded.
- __broaden__ τὸν: reading did not cover τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον (336, "the right-hand horse") or τὸν ἑόν (295); two clauses added.

Refused / left: the 17 other broadenings all begin with the old entry whole and cover their use; entry lengths over 230 in `__broaden__` are inherent to keeping the old entry whole. δοάσσεται lemma δοάζομαι and "aor. subj." kept (agrees with the unit note). εἰ broadening for 344 ("εἰ γάρ κ’ + subj.") kept although plain "if" already covers it; harmless. Digits in entries are only person/number labels ("3 sg."), not line numbers. units.json not touched.
